{{CharInfobox |color={{omega ruby color}} |corecolor={{omega ruby color light}} |bordercolor={{omega ruby color dark}} |name=Brodie |jname=バンナイ |tmname=Bannai |image=Brodie.png |size=230px |caption=Brodie |gender=Male |hometown=Unknown |region=[[Hoenn]] |relatives=Unknown |teamrank=Former member |leader=no |team=yes |teamname=[[Team Magma]] |brain=no |anime=yes |epnum=AG083 |epname=Unfair Weather Friends |enva=[[Andrew Paull]] |java=[[Katsuyuki Konishi]] }} '''Brodie''' (Japanese: '''バンナイ''' ''Bannai'') is a recurring character in {{aniseries|AG}}. ==History== [[File:Brodie Magma.png|thumb|left|220px|Brodie in [[Team Magma]]]] Brodie debuted in ''[[AG083|Unfair Weather Friends]]'', disguised as [[Millie]], a scientist at the [[Weather Institute]] who was supposed to be collecting data on {{p|Groudon}}. [[Team Aqua]] tried to steal the data directly, unaware Millie was really Brodie. When [[Shelly]] threatened to harm [[Bart]] and the other scientists at the Institute, Brodie revealed himself as a [[Team Magma]] Agent and escaped with the information the Institute had gathered on the [[Legendary Pokémon]]. Brodie reappeared in ''[[AG119|The Ribbon Cup Caper]]'' aboard the [[S.S. St. Flower]], which was en route to [[Slateport City]]. He disguised himself as various people, including [[Officer Jenny]], in order to steal the [[Ribbon Cup]] intended to the winner of the [[Hoenn Grand Festival]]. When confronted by the real Officer Jenny, Brodie willingly gave up the Ribbon Cup because upon closer inspection "it wasn't valuable enough," and flew away once again. He has not been seen since. {{-}} ==Character== Brodie was a member of [[Team Magma]] before their dissolution, after which he became known as "Brodie The Phantom Thief". He is also known as "The Man of a Thousand Faces", having perfected the art of disguising himself in order to get his goals accomplished, even being able to mimic people's voices perfectly. ==Gallery== :''See also: [[Cross-dressing]]'' {| style="margin:auto; text-align:center; font-size: 80%; {{roundy|2px}} border: 2px solid #{{omega ruby color dark}}; background: #{{omega ruby color}}; color:#fff" |- | style="{{roundy|2px}} border: 2px solid #{{omega ruby color dark}}; background: #{{omega ruby color light}}" | [[File:Brodie Millie.png|220px]] | style="{{roundy|2px}} border: 2px solid #{{omega ruby color dark}}; background: #{{omega ruby color light}}" | [[File:Brodie Captain.png|220px]] | style="{{roundy|2px}} border: 2px solid #{{omega ruby color dark}}; background: #{{omega ruby color light}}" | [[File:Brodie Lady.png|220px]] | style="{{roundy|2px}} border: 2px solid #{{omega ruby color dark}}; background: #{{omega ruby color light}}" | [[File:Brodie Chef.png|220px]] | style="{{roundy|2px}} border: 2px solid #{{omega ruby color dark}}; background: #{{omega ruby color light}}" | [[File:Brodie Jenny.png|220px]] |- | Disguised as {{color2|fff|Millie}} | Disguised as a Captain | Disguised as a {{tccolor|Lady|fff}} | Disguised as a Chef | Disguised as {{tccolor|Officer Jenny|fff}} |} ==Pokémon== {{MissingInfo|2|java|enva|scope=section}} This listing is of Brodie's known {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} in {{aniseries|PTS}}: {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Brodie |pkmn=Ditto |width=72 |type1=Normal |img=Brodie Ditto.png |epnum=AG083 |epname=Unfair Weather Friends |vajp=Megumi Hayashibara |vaen= |desc={{p|Ditto}} is Brodie's main partner and always sits on the shoulder of its Trainer.
